description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git diff behaviors, especially with whitespace handling, including setup procedures and various test assertions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and verifies the outcome.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs the specified command and expects it to fail, used to validate negative cases.

methods.name: test_must_pass
methods.description: Runs the specified command and expects it to succeed.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the testing script.
